title: Polysulfide Coordination Clusters of the Lanthanides

material_class.structural_family: trinuclear formamidinate-supported cluster with three bridging S4^2- ligands

synthesis.procedure: All manipulations were performed under exclusion of oxygen and moisture in Schlenk glassware or an argon glovebox. Method A ([(DippForm)3Sm3S12]·2(C7H8)·S8): toluene (25 mL) was condensed at -78 °C onto [(DippForm)2Sm(thf)2] (204 mg, 0.2 mmol) and S8 (25 mg, 0.1 mmol). The mixture was warmed to ambient temperature and stirred for 12 h, then heated at 60 °C for 12 h. The orange suspension was filtered into a 2-section ampoule and flame-sealed. Slow solvent evaporation at ambient temperature gave light-orange crystals containing two toluene and one S8 per cluster; crystals suitable for diffraction were also grown from C6D6 in an NMR tube. Yield 57 mg (72%, assuming [(DippForm)3Sm] forms in equal amount). Method B ([(DippForm)3Sm3S12]·3(C7H8)): toluene (50 mL) was condensed at -78 °C onto [(DippForm)2Sm(thf)2] (1020 mg, 1.0 mmol) and S8 (128 mg, 0.5 mmol). The mixture was warmed to ambient temperature, stirred for 6 h, then heated at 110 °C for 12 h. Toluene was removed in vacuum and the residue extracted with n-heptane (100 mL) at -20 °C. DippFormH crystallized from the solid residue. The n-heptane phase was filtered and evaporated to a yellow residue, which was dissolved in toluene; golden block crystals formed on concentration at ambient temperature. Yield 50 mg (13%, same assumption). Further concentration gave a mixture with [(DippForm)3Sm]. The main text states only that excess elemental sulfur reacts with [(DippForm)2Sm(thf)2] in toluene; quantities are in the SI.

synthesis.procedure: The SI states that 2 was prepared in the same way as [(DippForm)3Sm3S12]·2(C7H8)·S8 (Method A for 1): toluene condensed at -78 °C onto the divalent formamidinate precursor and S8, warm to ambient temperature (12 h), then 60 °C (12 h), filtration into a flame-sealed ampoule, and crystallization by slow evaporation. Deep-red crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction were obtained. The SI does not restate a separate mass or molar amount for [(DippForm)2Yb(thf)2] or S8. Yield 57 mg (35%). The main text describes reaction of [(DippForm)2Yb(thf)2] with excess elemental sulfur in toluene but gives no quantities.

material_class.structural_family: mononuclear formamidinate ytterbium chloride THF adduct

synthesis.procedure: An independent attempt to make [(DippForm)3Yb] from YbCl3 and in situ (DippForm)K instead gave the known complex [(DippForm)2YbCl(thf)]. THF (30 mL) was condensed at -78 °C onto DippFormH (364 mg, 1 mmol) and KH (40 mg, 1 mmol). The mixture was warmed to ambient temperature and refluxed for 24 h to a light-yellow solution. A suspension of YbCl3 (92 mg, 0.33 mmol) in THF (30 mL) was added and the mixture was refluxed for 48 h. Volatiles were removed in vacuum and the residue extracted with toluene. Yellow crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction grew from hot concentrated toluene. Yield 150 mg (45%). Composition matched published data.
synthesis.time: 24 h reflux for ligand deprotonation, then 48 h reflux after YbCl3 addition
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk/argon conditions; THF condensed onto solids; reflux
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Removal of volatiles, toluene extraction, and crystallization from hot concentrated toluene.
